d: Amandeep Singh, hailing from the historical city of Kurukshetra in Haryana, India, is a man whose feats of strength and endurance have left spectators spellbound. Not only does Amandeep possess an extraordinary level of muscular strength, but his resilience and ability to endure pain are also unparalleled. He has demonstrated this by withstanding the blows of heavy hammers on his chest, an act that speaks to his almost superhuman physical conditioning. In recognition of his unmatched prowess, Singh was bestowed with the title of 'Steel Man' at the Mr. Singh International event in 2009.…
